customManagers.description: Coder chart tag + OCI manifest digest in versions.yaml. The chart is an OCI artefact; the docker datasource supplies both the tag and its manifest digest.
The ArgoCD chart targetRevision must move with versions.yaml. No digest here: ArgoCD takes the tag, and the digest is checked by scripts/check-coder-pin.sh.
Coder server image tag@digest in versions.yaml.
The same server image tag@digest in the chart values.

The push script's pinned Coder CLI image. Same depName as the server image, so the package rule below moves every pin (chart tag+digest, server image tag+digest, this CLI image, ArgoCD targetRevision) in one PR.
The Coder template's qnsc-eda image. The digest is the identity; the moving `main` tag (moved by the qnsc-eda publish job) is what lets Renovate detect a new build and update the digest.

packageRules.description: Custom regex managers already carry (or deliberately omit) digests; do not let pinDigests rewrite a tag-only ArgoCD targetRevision.

The Coder chart and server image are one release: one PR moves the chart tag, the chart digest, the server image tag and its digest, and the ArgoCD targetRevision together. 14-day release-age floor (stable 2.38 line).
The qnsc-eda toolchain image (Coder template and RTL CI follow the same build) moves on a 14-day release-age floor, never automerged.
